fusions.name: Musk Spray
fusions.desc: Looses a cone of musk ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to everything caught in it, leaving each [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds and stunning it for 1 second.

fusions.name: Ruptured Gland
fusions.desc: Spits a gland that deals 36 damage to the first enemy it meets, ignoring its resistances.

fusions.name: Standing Reek
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to you for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Panic Spray
fusions.desc: When your health falls below 50%, a spray hits the nearest enemy within 4 tiles, dealing 10 damage. Once every 30 seconds.
